verification.method: All raw artifact, source-copy and full-live comparison checks finished before root released the renderer profiling lane. Assembly reads only retained metadata and uses those completed checks; no whole-tree rehash during profiling.

limits: actual_exit is the preserved serial runner forwarded process exit, not a number inferred from assertions.
The raw engine banner is retained. Original run receipts do not hash executable binary bytes; this aggregate does not retroactively bind them.
Wrappers admit warnings generally, not through a strict allowlist. Only the named found-art warning appears in the reviewed raw runs.
Runtime manifests bind project/scripts/scenes/tests/data text inputs, not all binary assets. Older full digests remain distinct from the final reviewed source.
Focused owner/presence callbacks and same-process save/load are not human physical traversal, a full-day soak or separate-process restart proofs.
New per-field basis is campaign_elapsed_minutes. Unqualified legacy host values remain unchanged; no duration/expiry consequence or unit relabeling is added.
Adoption archives exact legacy_order/id and records adopted_at rather than fabricated issuance; conflicting history refuses retirement.

Incident omission raises a real persistence latch from the real order-issued callback; it is a callback-window simulation, not physical disk failure. Register building and incident survey presence are supplied fixture inputs.

Final timestamp/jobs/register full1160-input manifests matched live before profiling. Earlier errand/incidents/calendar/save-compatibility runs precede hearing and two fixture revisions; exact differences remain in each run.
Earlier save restart proof and deeper scalar/ID-validation debt retain their prior scope. Pure IDs and dream entropy exemptions are unchanged.

regression_fixture_revision.reason: Job fixture preserves complete conflicting source histories. Register adds only at_basis, checks its exact basis, and tests LF/CRLF whole-comment removal while retaining executable foreign-owner code. Original ownership predicates are unchanged.
regression_fixture_revision.early_capture_limit: Early wrappers hash the complete runtime set but do not copy selected regression scene/script separately. Exact old fixture bytes retained in the revision package match those run manifests.
